Beautiful website templates built with Tailwind CSS

Website templates crafted with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Ideal for launching your next project with a modern tech stack.

«Planner»

Dashboard Template for SaaS or Internal Tool

Live preview
Download .zip file
Deploy to Vercel
Advanced tables
Interactive charts & custom tooltips
Powerful layout elements
Built with modern tools.
Work with data easily.

«Planner» is the perfect template for visualizing simple data. Build your first reporting tool or integrate it into your existing SaaS. It's based on Next.js 15 and is written in TypeScript, with a thoughtful component structure and accessibility in mind.

All content is headless by design, with a default dark mode and full customization capabilities. This makes it perfect for customer-facing analytics, seamlessly aligning with your corporate identity.

All content is headless by design, and full customization capabilities. This makes it easy to seamlessly align it with your corporate identity.
